summary: Blueprint 26 (Asset Exit, Resale & Responsible Disposition Engine) tested end-to-end: 21/21 backend pytest cases pass; user + admin frontend flows verified on mobile & desktop viewports respectively. Backend covers config, case create/list/detail, assess, AI valuation+options generation, compare with highlights + disclaimer, select (private_sale returns safety), listing draft + review, safety, complete + asset lifecycle mapping, valuation flag, admin dashboard (7 seeded partners visible), category enable/disable (disabled category returns 400 for user), partner CRUD, compensated-without-disclosure returns 400, non-admin RBAC returns 401/403 on all admin routes. Frontend: HI dashboard hi-exit tile → /home-intel/exit → exit-start sheet with title + category chips → exit-create routes to case screen → cond-Good + work-working chips + exit-damage + exit-assess-submit → exit-compare-btn runs AI + shows Homie's picks highlights (best_overall = Private sale for Good/Working item) + option cards + partner rows + choose/handled buttons → choose private_sale surfaces listing card with exit-listing-btn → exit-listing-review works → handled-donation → complete-value + complete-confirm → Done card. Admin: left nav shows admin-nav-homiehq, admin-nav-assetexit, admin-nav-rewardsfunding as expected; Asset Exit module renders stats (5 cases / 3 completed / $600 realized / 0 flags), category toggle switches, exit partners with pause/remove, add-partner form with client-side + server-side compensated/disclosure guard. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by B26. No React Native red screens. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: asset_exit_engine.py in _build_options: for `dispose` (factor=None) an unavailable option keeps status='needs_verification' via the trailing override for recycle/donation/dispose — status semantics are consistent with UI but note that dispose without a partner still shows as needs_verification rather than unavailable; acceptable.

In select(), exit_partner_matches.update_many resets ALL matches for the case to 'active' before marking one as 'selected'; fine but any prior 'selected' state is silently overwritten (idempotent by design).
Server enforces category enablement only on POST /cases; existing in-flight cases in a disabled category continue to work (expected).
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ was created via API: 2 exit cases (iPhone 12, Broken microwave) + 1 partner (TEST_GoodPartner — added, patched, deleted in same test) + 1 UI-created case (TEST_UI Old Drill). Furniture category briefly disabled and re-enabled inside a try/finally.
